content.text: I found no known-issue, release-note, or workaround information for an iOS update that crashes notes with attached PDFs. My tools only search Lumen tickets, and none of the matches describe this crash, so the ticket is the only record. Ticket t008 is a high-priority bug, and the customer reports that PDF-attached notes close the app on iOS since the last update, before a Friday exam.
